title: Norml Connect
pitch: Connect provider tools with explicit identity and read-only target verification.
problem: Existing logins and file names do not prove the intended account can operate the intended target.
This package checks exact identity and resource state before continuing.

items: No automatic production mutations or paid tests.
Provider account access must be verified on the recipient’s machine.

items.desc: Provider setup, verification and known obstacles.
